highlights: Mandatory police check/clearance and criminal records disclosure for all employees
Comprehensive Child Protection Policy ensuring students have the right to be safe, respected, and listened to
Mandatory Health Form and medical history submission for all students
Strict dress code and identity management enhancing campus security
safety.policy_summary: Crescent International School is deeply committed to student safety and well-being through a structured Child Protection Policy. The policy ensures that all adults interacting regularly with students are informed of student rights and undergo mandatory criminal background checks/police clearances. Furthermore, any reported concerns or allegations are taken seriously and handled in strict compliance with the Thailand Child Protection Act of 2003.
